slice: Remote-sensing CSV location and plot-lineage scope

implementation.single_location: Loads only plot UUIDs present in the CSV whose farm belongs to the selected location; unknown/out-of-scope plots are rejected before insertion.
implementation.aggregate_mode: Preserves multi-location CSV import only when --all-locations is explicitly selected and limits the plot lookup to IDs present in the CSV.
implementation.row_lineage: Plot and optional CSV location UUIDs are canonicalized; an optional row location must match the plot's farm-derived location.
implementation.idempotency: Source digest uses canonical plot/location lineage for accepted rows.

verification.repository_inventory: 66 capabilities, 66 service groups, 464 test files, 0 parse errors

limitations: Tests use mocked database/provider boundaries and synthetic CSV files; no PostgreSQL or external provider was contacted.
Location selectors and plot/farm checks do not authenticate an operator or establish database-level tenant isolation/RLS.
No candidate or legacy database, persisted schedule, or live deployment was accessed.
